releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## What changed

- Renamed the plugin from Just Tabs to Tabsdown, including its plugin ID and installation paths.
- Updated the block syntax to use fenced `tabsdown` blocks with `tab: Label` markers.
- Added per-block tab placement and layout options, including top, bottom, left, right, single-line scrolling, and wrapping labels.
- Added support for both backtick and tilde fences.
- Expanded Style Settings with compact sizing, underline tabs, overflow behavior, palette choices, and an optional accent override.
- Updated the documentation and templates for the new syntax and settings.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## First stable release

Tabsdown is now ready for everyday use.

- Create accessible, theme-native tabbed sections from ordinary Markdown.
- Keep links, embeds, queries, and other Markdown-renderable content together in compact tabs.
- Navigate tabs with a mouse, touch, or keyboard in Reading View and Live Preview.
- Customize the tab layout through Style Settings or CSS snippets.

Thank you to everyone who tested the beta and helped make this stable release possible.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## First public beta

Tabsdown introduces accessible Markdown tab blocks for Obsidian.

- Create tabbed sections with a fenced `tabs` block.
- Render Markdown, Dataview queries, and other compatible content inside tabs.
- Use tabs in Reading View and Live Preview.
- Adjust spacing, alignment, density, and corners with Style Settings.
- Generate tab blocks with the included Templater recipes.

Tested on macOS and iPhone with Obsidian 1.13.3. This is a beta release; please report reproducible problems through GitHub Issues.
